name: second-brain-memory
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code over your own markdown notes: registers the sqlite-graph-memory MCP server (vector + wikilink-graph recall on plain SQLite). Separate from the skills plugin because it downloads the embedding models (about 155 MB with the [lite] ONNX stack) on first start. Layers and design: https://github.com/tonydzi/second-brain-starter-kit/blob/master/MEMORY.md

author.name: Anton Dziatkovskii / Palo Alto AI Research Lab

index_dir.title: Index directory
index_dir.description: The folder `sgm-index` wrote for your notes (BRAIN_INDEX_DIR). Build it once with: uvx --python 3.12 --from 'sqlite-graph-memory[lite]>=0.3.6,<0.4' sgm-index <your notes folder>
